_readme: Which projects get their generator code archived into this repo.
Project metadata and all 1,802,387 iteration seeds are already committed under
public/data. Generator code is not: it lives on IPFS and runs 80-150 GB for the
full catalog. A generator plus a seed regenerates an artwork, so any project
listed here keeps working with no IPFS, no Tezos and no internet.
'rules' selects projects automatically. 'projects' holds individual entries,
normally added from a preservation request issue.
Scope is Tezos only; fxhash's Ethereum and Base projects are not supported yet.

rules._topProjectsByVolume: Rank by primary + secondary volume in tez. Measured across a 600-project sample: the top 1% of projects account for 73.2% of all money that moved on the platform, so a small list covers most of what people actually engaged with. Mints are a poor substitute (top 1% = only 17.4%) because a large free edition is not the same as interest.
rules._includeOnchfs: 372 projects store their code on-chain via onchfs://. They cost nothing to archive and can never be lost, so they are always included.
rules._artists: Every project by these artists, regardless of volume.
rules._maxProjectSizeMB: Skip generators larger than this and leave them to IPFS. The size distribution has a long tail (median 837 KB among top-volume projects, but individual generators reach 30 MB), and a handful of outliers would otherwise consume the entire budget. Set to 0 to disable the cap.
